description: This source file defines a utility class 'Reflect' providing methods for introspection and reflection on Java classes, including checking for collection types, retrieving fields, and inheritance relationships.

classes.name: Reflect
classes.description: A utility class providing reflection-based methods to inspect Java classes, fields, and types, especially focusing on collection types and inheritance relationships.

methods.name: Reflect
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Reflect utility with a specific class for use in type checks.

methods.name: isCollection (Class<?>)
methods.description: Checks whether a given Class object represents a Collection type.

methods.name: isCollection (Object)
methods.description: Checks whether a given object is an instance of a Collection.

methods.name: getAllFields
methods.description: Retrieves all declared fields (including private) from a class and its superclasses.

methods.name: isAnnotationPresent
methods.description: Checks if a specific annotation is present on a named field within a class.

methods.name: isSuperClass (Class)
methods.description: Checks whether a class is a subclass or subtype of the class used during Reflect initialization.

methods.name: isSuperClass (Type)
methods.description: Determines if a type is a subclass or bounded by a subclass of the initialized class.

methods.name: isSuperClass (Object)
methods.description: Checks if an object's class is a subclass of the class used during Reflect initialization.

methods.name: isCollectionField
methods.description: Validates whether a field is a collection with elements of a specified parameterized type.

methods.name: getInheritedFields
methods.description: Retrieves only the fields from a subclass that are declared in or inherited from the class used during Reflect initialization.

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks if a field is declared in, or a subclass of, the class used during Reflect initialization.
